problem: Fragmented MP4 parsing never inspects mfhd inside moof (accepting moof boxes without mfhd, duplicate mfhd boxes, overlong mfhd payloads, and zero sequence_number) and accepts trex boxes with track_ID == 0 or duplicate track_ID entries in mvex (silently ignoring the second trex).
reference_provenance: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.3 (TrackExtendsBox: exactly one per track, non-zero track_ID) and 8.8.4/8.8.5 (MovieFragmentBox / MovieFragmentHeaderBox: mandatory singleton mfhd per moof, version 0, 8-byte payload, 1-based positive sequence_number).
scope: Pure owned 3-frame 16x16 VP9 fMP4 at 50 Hz. Controls cover regular MP4, single-fragment fMP4, three-fragment sequential fMP4, and multi-track trex with distinct track IDs. Malformed cases cover missing mfhd, duplicate mfhd, zero mfhd sequence_number, overlong 12-byte mfhd, zero trex track_ID, and duplicate trex track_ID.
requirements: Reproduce pre-fix silent acceptance of all 6 malformed mfhd and trex inputs before editing production code.
Require a singleton version-0 8-byte mfhd with non-zero sequence_number in every moof and non-zero unique track_ID values across mvex/trex in src/container/mp4.rs.
Preserve exact packets, sync flags, clocks, budgets, analytic VP9 planes/RGB, 32 public clamped seek targets, rewind, and repeated EOF across all healthy controls.
Run focused, related MP4/HLS/VP9, unit, minimal-configuration, fixture unittest, and player build gates.
implementation_plan: Validate required(&moof_boxes, b"mfhd"), version 0, len == 8, and non-zero sequence_number in index_fragments; validate non-zero unique track_ID in fragment_defaults.
counting: One fragmented MP4 mfhd header and trex track-ID integrity fix (FVID-0183). No extra IDs for individual mfhd/trex variants, controls, or fixture generator.
